part3.title: Part 3 – Complete the Story
part3.instruction: Read the story. Choose a word from the box. Write the correct word next to numbers 1–10. There is one example.
part3.storyText: My name is Daisy. I like toys, but I like books and [example: comics] best. part4.title: Part 4 – Factual Text
part4.instruction: Read the text. Choose the right words and write them on the lines.
paragraphs: Cats have very good eyes. They can see very well at night. (1) ________ cats climb trees and eat meat.
They can move very quietly when they hunt and catch small animals. Then they eat them. They have strong, sharp teeth.
There (2) ________ small cats that live in houses and big wild cats like lions and tigers. Only tigers live (3) ________ the deep jungle.
Lions don't live in jungles; they prefer open grasslands. Some people go and see lions and tigers at the zoo.
A lot of people have small cats in (4) ________ homes. These cats are pets. People (5) ________ them because they are cute and gentle.
Pet cats like sleeping in warm places. They (6) ________ drink milk or water and eat special cat food.
When cats are happy, they make a soft sound called purring. They can sleep for more (7) ________ twelve hours every day!
Kittens are baby cats. They are born with (8) ________ eyes closed and start opening them after one week.
Cats use their long whiskers to feel (9) ________ around them when moving in the dark.
That is why cats are such (10) ________ amazing pets for families around the world.

part5.title: Part 5 – Complete Sentences about the Story
part5.instruction: Look at the pictures and read the story. Write 1, 2 or 3 words to complete the sentences about the story.

storyPassages.text: Vicky lives with her parents and her two brothers, Sam and Paul, in the city. Last week, they had a wonderful holiday by the sea. Sam is ten, Vicky is eight, but Paul is only five. They went to the cinema on Wednesday because it rained heavily all day long. They saw a movie about giant sharks. The sharks had very big, sharp teeth! Paul didn't like watching them at all and he closed his eyes.

On Thursday morning, Paul was still thinking about the scary movie. He didn't want to swim in the sea. He sat on the beach towel and watched Sam and Vicky. They played happily in the water. Mum gave Paul a delicious strawberry ice cream, but he didn't want to eat it. Then Dad said, 'Come on Paul! Let me take you for a swim.' But Paul shook his head and stayed on the sand.

On Friday, the family ate breakfast in the garden because it was very sunny. Then they all went to the beach again. The sea was very blue and clear. Paul looked into the water. There were three beautiful, friendly dolphins swimming near the shore! He ran right into the sea and swam towards them. Then Paul's dad threw a red ball into the sea and the dolphins played with it. That evening, all the family went to the cinema again. This time the movie was about a funny dolphin and everybody enjoyed it!

part6.instruction: Look at the picture and answer the questions. Write full sentences or short descriptions on the lines.
part6.promptText: Look closely at the bear family in the bathroom and answer all 10 questions.

questions.text: There are five white ________ hanging in the bathroom.
